name: HandoverSim
description: We introduce a new simulation benchmark "HandoverSim" for human-to-robot object handovers. To simulate the giver's motion, we leverage a recent motion capture dataset of hand grasping of objects. We create training and evaluation environments for the receiver with standardized protocols and metrics. We analyze the performance of a set of baselines and show a correlation with a real-world evaluation. Code is open sourced at https://handover-sim.github.io.
evaluation_method: task_success_rate (successful handovers), complemented by metrics such as completion time, positional error at transfer, and stability
reputation: Open-source simulation benchmark with growing interest in the human-to-robot handover research community.
notes: Sim-to-real gap can be significant; relies on a specific motion-capture-derived giver behavior distribution and may need domain randomization. Not an LLM benchmark; realism and diversity of human behaviors are potential limitations.
